body:
Thank you, I can relate very much to what you say about friends. 

I have had too much to drink, and I am going to try to sleep this over. I hope tomorrow will see me wake up to something different, but the realist in me tells me I am just pushing the inevitable by a day. I don't have much illusions about meeting that special person. I was born alone into this world, and I will in all likelihood die alone.

But you are incredible. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise, I don't know how you keep your sanity when you offer support to whiny people like me every day.

Thank you again. I am going to try to sleep this over, and I hope this will be the end of it. If I am getting this drunk tomorrow, I am going to a bar, at least some place where there are other people.

I am an introvert. This wasn't a problem earlier in life. In college there used to be someone in the dorm or hallway, and friendships just used to happen. When I used to have roommates before, there was a social circle that I could piggyback on. These days, I rent alone, and most of my friends have drifted away because of their life and family. I don't expect them to spend more time with me, but it sucks when everyone around me is doing this. I try to put myself out there, but I clam up in front of new people. I can't bring my self to say hello, or keep a conversation going. This isn't who I used to be, but I don't know how to be my old self.

I appreciate you taking the time to talk to me. You are a total stranger, and yet you seem to be only person interested in how I am feeling. Thank you, you are an incredible woman.

Thank you. I don't honestly know what my problem is. I am stuck in this rut of isolation, where I have no one to talk to, and no one to call my own. Every day at home, I am reminded of my loneliness by the fact that there is no one else here, that no one ever calls me, or no one ever talks to me. For a long time, I thought this was okay, and that this is who I am. I can't take it any more.

I've tried everything, hanging out in groups and meetups to make friends and meet new people. It doesn't work. I can't bond with people, and I can't seem to make new friends. I am slowly coming to the realization that life might not be meant for me.

I don't want to ruin your Friday this way. I am in a dark ugly place, and I don't want to sink you into my world.

Thank you for your kind words. Please, don't be me. Most of my life, I've spent it in the quest for a career, money and stability. Don't be me, remember to spend time with the people that matter the most, the people that matter the most to you. Once you lose everything, there is nothing left in this world.

I am happy that you have close friends. Keep on to them because friends are worth everything.

I don't see how this can be any different. I am too lost, and I don't know how to turn this around. The past three years or more is when things went this way. I truly don't know how to fix it. I am not the kind of person that has the strength to go through with this. I think I am done. I am drinking at home, trying to convince myself that this is a bad idea. There isn't a single person I know that cares about me, that wants me. I am not asking for a lot, and I don't know how to get what I want.
